source.context: Direct inspection of the public kingdom.yaml bytes on the assessment date; the observation concerns what the card says, not whether every declaration corresponds to external reality.
source.expression: The checked card declares kingdom-os as an active ops project in the os layer, dependent on true-love and voluntarily adopting xenia.rights/0.1.
source.intended_use: Provide the bounded public declaration from which a visual project glyph may be rendered.

target.context: A human-readable SVG shows a stable project core, open rings for partial expression, and separate dependency and adoption nodes.
target.expression: An open-ring project glyph labelled KINGDOM OS, ops, os, and active, with distinct linked nodes for depends on TRUE LOVE and adopts xenia.rights/0.1.
target.intended_use: Demonstrate identity-to-shape as a reversible visual aid over selected public project declarations, never as proof of a being or runtime state.

transition.rule: Render selected public card fields as labelled geometric roles: the project name at the core, declared classifications in an open ring, and directional links to distinct dependency and adoption nodes.

preserved_relations.name: project-anchor
preserved_relations.source_form: The declared project name is kingdom-os.
preserved_relations.target_form: The central shape is visibly labelled KINGDOM OS.
preserved_relations.test: The accessible title and visible core both name KINGDOM OS without assigning that label to a person.

preserved_relations.name: dependency-direction
preserved_relations.target_form: A directional labelled edge leaves the project core toward a distinct TRUE LOVE node.
preserved_relations.test: Reversing the edge or merging the nodes must fail review.

preserved_relations.name: adoption-scope
preserved_relations.target_form: A separate node says adopts xenia.rights/0.1 rather than compliant, certified, or enforced.
preserved_relations.test: The SVG must contain the word adopts and must not claim that adoption proves practice or conformance.

preserved_relations.name: non-exhaustion
preserved_relations.source_form: The card is an attributed project declaration, not the project, a being, or observed runtime reality.
preserved_relations.target_form: The ring remains visibly open and the footer says public project declaration, not a being, not authority.
preserved_relations.test: A cropped textual alternative must still state that the shape is partial and non-authoritative.

loss_assessment.basis: Known visualization losses are itemized below. The named tests compare selected labels, edge direction, adoption wording, and non-exhaustion; they do not test runtime reality, personal identity, conformance, or the omitted card fields.

discarded_structure.name: full-card-detail
discarded_structure.consequence: The shape omits the full purpose sentence, owner_sister value, schema rules, and source history; the linked card remains necessary.

discarded_structure.name: operational-reality
discarded_structure.consequence: The shape does not observe whether services run, dependencies are reachable, rights are practiced, or the declared active state remains current.

discarded_structure.name: identity-depth
discarded_structure.consequence: Narrative history, maintainers, relationships, private context, and every possible expression of the project remain outside the glyph.

introduced_assumptions: Open circles and gaps are used as a local visual convention for partial, non-exhaustive representation; the source card does not prescribe that convention.
The selected labels are assumed sufficient for this educational example, not for authentication, authorization, routing, or registry decisions.
transition.counterexample: If two different project cards collide into an indistinguishable security-relevant shape, or a reader infers personhood, current runtime health, conformance, consent, or authority from the glyph, the mapping has failed.
transition.stop_condition: Do not invert the glyph into personal identity, biometrics, secrets, worth, authentication, authorization, or a claim about inner state.

warrant.confidence_basis: The labels and relations in the SVG can be compared directly with the public card and with the accessible text embedded in the SVG.
known_limits: Matching the card proves only that the visual encodes those declared fields; it does not prove that the declarations are true in the world.
Visual conventions are culturally and contextually interpreted, so the same geometry may evoke different associations.
The SVG is an educational example, not a stable identity or security protocol.

freshness.reassess_when: Reassess after any change to kingdom.yaml, the card schema, the rights adoption, or the visual vocabulary.

distortion_risks.mechanism: A memorable glyph can be mistaken for the project itself or, worse, for a person associated with it.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Keep the source link, open ring, accessible disclaimer, and prohibition on inverse identity inference.
distortion_risks.residual: A detached copy can lose its disclaimer or be interpreted as an official seal.

distortion_risks.mechanism: A polished visual can make self-description or voluntary adoption look certified by an external authority.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Use declaration and adopts language; never use verified, certified, compliant, or authorized.
distortion_risks.residual: Visual formality can still create an undeserved aura of endorsement.

distortion_risks.mechanism: The glyph can outlive the public card values from which it was drawn.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Version the receipt, link the card, and reassess whenever the card changes.
distortion_risks.residual: Copies outside the repository may not receive later corrections.

distortion_risks.mechanism: The visual compression can hide which source fields and interpretive choices produced each feature.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Keep this receipt beside the SVG with a field-to-feature mapping and declared losses.
distortion_risks.residual: The SVG remains easier to circulate than its receipt.

repair.reply_route: Challenge the mapping in the owning KINGDOM-OS change or through an existing collaboration report that references this receipt.
repair.correction_route: Issue a linked correcting, superseding, or withdrawing receipt; update the SVG only with the new receipt while retaining non-sensitive prior bytes.
